sample_106708.headline: 隨著歐洲與東南亞吸納越來越多國際護理人員，全球護理人員遷徙模式正發生轉變
sample_106708.subHeadLine: 《TruMerit 2025年護理人員遷移報告》揭示，各地區之間的人力資源不平等現象正日益加劇。
sample_106708.bodyText:
TruMerit™（前身為 CGFNS International）今日發布《2025年護理人員遷移報告》，揭示全球護理人員遷移模式出現顯著變化，且在醫療保健需求差異極大的各區域間，護理人力分布的不平等現象正日益加劇。

該報告透過分析世界衛生組織的數據及 TruMerit 專有的 VisaScreen® 申請紀錄，顯示國際護理人員的流動正日益集中於醫療基礎設施較完善的地區，而面臨嚴重護理人力短缺的地區，在僱用國際教育背景護理人員的能力方面則持續處於劣勢。

歐洲與東南亞地區的國際護理師僱用量呈現急遽增長。根據TruMerit對世衛組織護理人力數據的分析… [truncated, full length 1662]
sample_106708.bodyHtml: 賓夕法尼亞州費城, 2026年4月28日 - (亞太商訊) - TruMerit™（前身為 CGFNS International）今日發布《2025年護理人員遷移報告》，揭示全球護理人員遷移模式出現顯著變化，且在醫療保健需求差異極大的各區域間，護理人力分布的不平等現象正日益加劇。
sample_106708.summary: TruMerit™（前身為 CGFNS International）今日發布《2025年護理人員遷移報告》，揭示全球護理人員遷移模式出現顯著變化，且在醫療保健需求差異極大的各區域間，護理人力分布的不平等現象正日益加劇。

actual.body: Service Unavailable (HTML error page, 1264 bytes - not JSON)

mismatches.actual: Real JSON array - ["Enterprise IT","Aerospace & Defence","Artificial Intel [AI]","Automation [IoT]"]
mismatches.impact: None at runtime: parseSectors() accepts both. The TYPE DECLARATION is stale - NewApiPressRelease.sectors should be `string[] | string | null`.

mismatches.actual: Absent from the response entirely on both samples.
mismatches.impact: None - the adapter only reads it as a fallback after `sectors`. But the type lies about the wire format.

mismatches.expected: Documented and coded as LEGACY-ONLY. The second (503) HTTP call exists chiefly to obtain it.
mismatches.actual: The NEW API now returns it: "EN" on 109894, "ZH-TW" on 106708.
mismatches.impact: Positive. Verified both codes resolve through src/lib/languages.ts ALIASES ("en", "zh tw" -> zh-Hant), so canonicalisation to /article/traditional-chinese/... is correct today WITHOUT the legacy call. This weakens the main justification for keeping PR-LEGACY.

mismatches.field: supplier, location, url, views, company socials
mismatches.actual: Legacy is 503 and the new API returns none of them -> every article renders supplier "", location {name:"",sub_Location:""}, url "", views "0", and no company social icons.
mismatches.impact: Not a crash - these are the permanently-blank fields on every live article page. views showing "0" on every release is the visible symptom.

mismatches.actual: The API returns MULTIPLE companies on co-issued releases - 109894 returns 2 (companyID 82 MHI and 86 NEC).
mismatches.impact: Second and later issuers are silently dropped from the article page. A joint announcement credits only the first company.

mismatches.expected: Boolean flag stating whether the article has an image.
mismatches.actual: Unreliable: 109894 returns hasImage=false while images[] contains {"bigImage":"NEC-pic.jpg"}.
mismatches.impact: None today - the adapter ignores hasImage and reads images[0].bigImage. Any future consumer branching on hasImage will hide a real image.

mismatches.actual: `body` is null on every article sampled; `bodyHtml` always carries the markup.
mismatches.impact: None - the `raw.bodyHtml ?? raw.body` fallback is never exercised.

mismatches.expected: Sanitised before leaving the service layer, as every neighbouring field is.
mismatches.actual: Returned raw by the adapter. Safe for the rendered page (Body.tsx sanitises twice) but /api/press-release/{id} still serves it unsanitised.
mismatches.impact: Pre-existing known finding, restated because it is visible in this capture. Any consumer not rendering through Body.tsx is unprotected.

verdict.endpointHealth: HEALTHY - primary returns 200 with a complete payload and 404s correctly on unknown ids.
